description: This file defines an abstract Controller class for the Search UI MVC framework within SuiteCRM, including methods for handling requests, rendering views, redirecting, AJAX detection, and JSON responses.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a generic controller for the Search Framework, managing request handling, view rendering, redirection, AJAX detection, and JSON output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a View object.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, dispatching to specific actions or default display.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects the client to a specified URL.

methods.name: isAjax
methods.description: Detects if the request was made via AJAX.

methods.name: yieldJson
methods.description: Outputs data as JSON with appropriate headers, handling encoding errors.

methods.name: isActionRequest
methods.description: Checks if the current request corresponds to a controller action.

methods.name: getActionName
methods.description: Retrieves and sanitizes the action name from GET parameters.
